cohort: The study included women diagnosed with severe preeclampsia or eclampsia who delivered at Arifin Achmad General Hospital, Pekanbaru between January 2014 and December 2015.
finding: Mothers aged >35 were three times as likely to develop severe preeclampsia-eclampsia compared to those aged <=35, and gestational age showed the strongest association with eclampsia.
mod_finding: Mothers with severe preeclampsia or eclampsia had a five times greater risk of having delivered via Cesarean Section or operative vaginal delivery compared to non-preeclamptic/eclamptic mothers.
cross-section timing: Data was collected for women who delivered between January 2014 and December 2015.
gest_age: Both term and preterm pregnancies were included and analysed.
